tools.name: database_info
tools.description:

journal mode, WAL checkpoint status, total size in bytes, freelist (unused)
page count, and the number of tables and indexes. Useful for monitoring
database health and understanding storage characteristics.

inputSchema.title: DatabaseInfoInput

database_size_bytes.description: The total database size in bytes, computed as `page_size * page_count`.

freelist_count.description:
The number of unused pages on the freelist, as reported by `PRAGMA
freelist_count`.

index_count.description: The number of indexes in the database, counted from `sqlite_master`.

page_count.description:
The total number of pages in the database file, as reported by `PRAGMA
page_count`.

page_size.description: The database page size in bytes, as configured by `PRAGMA page_size`.

table_count.description: The number of tables in the database, counted from `sqlite_master`.

wal_checkpoint.description:
WAL checkpoint information, present only when the journal mode is

Information from a passive WAL checkpoint, as returned by `PRAGMA
wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)`.

busy.description: Non-zero if the checkpoint was blocked by a concurrent reader or writer.

checkpointed_pages.description:
The number of pages successfully checkpointed back to the main database
file.

log_pages.description: The number of pages in the WAL log file.

tools.name: list_foreign_keys
tools.description:
List all foreign key constraints for a given table. Returns one entry per
column mapping, including the referenced table, the local and remote
columns, and the ON UPDATE / ON DELETE actions. Composite foreign keys
produce multiple entries that share the same id.

params.name: table_name
params.description: The name of the table to list foreign keys for

table_name.description: The name of the table to list foreign keys for

inputSchema.description: The input parameters for the `list_foreign_keys` tool.
inputSchema.title: ListForeignKeysInput

foreign_keys.description:
The foreign key constraints found on the table. Each entry represents
one column mapping within a foreign key. Composite keys produce multiple
entries sharing the same `id`.

ForeignKeyInfo.description:
A single column mapping within a foreign key constraint. Multiple rows with
the same `id` indicate a composite foreign key that spans more than one
column.

from_column.description: The column in the local table that participates in the foreign key.

id.description:
The foreign key constraint identifier. All column mappings belonging to
the same composite key share this value.

on_delete.description:
The action taken on deletion of the referenced row (e.g. `"NO ACTION"`,
`"CASCADE"`, `"SET NULL"`, `"SET DEFAULT"`, `"RESTRICT"`).

on_update.description:
The action taken on update of the referenced row (e.g. `"NO ACTION"`,
`"CASCADE"`, `"SET NULL"`, `"SET DEFAULT"`, `"RESTRICT"`).

to_column.description: The referenced column in the parent table.

outputSchema.description: The result of listing foreign keys for a table.
outputSchema.title: ListForeignKeysOutput
